title: Dashboard
subtitle: Save queried data to a local SQLite warehouse, then build a dashboard from it or inspect the rows.

help.title: How to use this page
help.intro: This page keeps your query results as snapshots in a local SQLite warehouse on this machine, so you can chart them later without re-running the query.
help.saveGrid: Save the current grid — run a query (or upload a file) in the Query tab, then press Save data in the results toolbar. The rows are copied into the local warehouse, so later re-queries do not change saved data.
help.manage: Manage snapshots — click a row in the list to open it. Use to load a snapshot's rows back into the Query grid, to update a snapshot from the current result grid (existing visuals are kept), to rename, and to delete.
help.relationships: Relationships — link two snapshots on a shared column (e.g. NAME = NAME), then use Explore to drill from a row in one table to its related rows in the other, or to preview the flat joined table. Relationships are saved in the warehouse and can be edited or deleted at any time.
help.dashboardTab: Dashboard tab — persistent visuals saved with the snapshot: add charts/tables, then edit, duplicate, move, resize or remove each tile.
help.chartTab: Chart tab — describe the dashboard you want in plain language; the AI reads this snapshot's column names and designs several charts. Preview each one, untick the ones you do not want, then pin the rest to the dashboard.
help.dataTab: Data tab — inspect the stored rows (first 200 shown).
help.storage: All snapshots are stored per-machine under <storagePath>%APPDATA%\ODBCQueryApp\data\</storagePath> — nothing is uploaded to a server.
